newsitem.title: UK: Sears set to sell mail order unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sears set to sell mail order unit - paper.

text.p: Retailer Sears Plc is set to put its Freemans mail order operations up for sale amid institutional pressure for a company shake-up, The Guardian newspaper said on Thursday.
German mail order giant Otto Versand and British mail order group N Brown have been mooted as possible buyers, the paper said, adding analysts estimated Freemans may be worth about 500 million stg.
The Guardian said details of the planned Freemans divestment leaked into the stock market on Wednesday. A Sears spokesman declined to comment, the paper added.
Institutional investors were dissatisfied with the shares' performance since Sears' chief executive Liam Strong joined the company in 1992, the Guardian said.
Sears shares closed 2-1/2 pence higher at 92-1/2 pence on Wednesday.
